moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio lk-crt, written here): Overlay: 1 px dark lines every 2-3 px at 15-22 % opacity, plus a 30 px white band at 12 % opacity rolling top -> bottom over 3000 ms linear, looping. Params: pitch (2–3 px) · opacity (15–22 %) · band (30 px, 3 s).
